name: SOC-007: Windows Lateral Movement Detected
description: Detects Windows lateral movement attempts including PsExec execution, WMI remote process creation, PowerShell Remoting, and WinRM usage.
aql_expression: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%Windows%' AND (payload ILIKE '%psexec%' OR payload ILIKE '%paexec%' OR payload ILIKE '%wmic%/node:%' OR payload ILIKE '%Enter-PSSession%' OR payload ILIKE '%Invoke-Command%' OR payload ILIKE '%winrs%-r:%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
